subject.title: WhatsApp: Backfill missed messages after reconnection

question: Should WhatsApp reconnect recovery attempt provider-side history/backfill for monitored chats, emit only an explicit gap warning when Baileys emits no event, or keep the current bounded append-only behavior?
rationale: Current main only solves Baileys-delivered reconnect append events; provider-side history sync affects privacy, replay bounds, read receipts, default behavior, and live proof expectations.

options.title: Design bounded backfill plus warning
options.body: Add monitored-chat, deduped, live-proven backfill where provider history is reliable and warn when the gap cannot be recovered.

options.title: Warn only for unrecoverable gaps
options.body: Avoid replaying history for now and make reconnect health/logs clearly report that messages may have been missed when no event arrives.

options.title: Keep append-only recovery
options.body: Accept current main behavior as the intended scope and close only after explicitly rejecting provider-side backfill as product direction.

recommendation.title: Design bounded backfill plus warning
recommendation.body: Add monitored-chat, deduped, live-proven backfill where provider history is reliable and warn when the gap cannot be recovered.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent durable inbound ownership and the maintainer comment on the remaining provider-side gap make this the best available routing candidate.
